_about: Public-domain Edwards Amasa Park (1808-1900), Abbot Professor at Andover, last of the New England theologians, for the Word Hoard: Discourses on some Theological Doctrines (1885), his Memorial Collection of Sermons (1902) and the Memoir of Samuel Hopkins (1854), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 47 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

park-discourses: Discourses on some theological doctrines. as related to the religious character (Andover [Mass.] : Warren F. Draper, 1885)
park-memorial-sermons: Memorial collection of sermons (Boston, Pilgrim Press, 1902)
park-memoir-hopkins: Memoir of the life and character of Samuel Hopkins, D. D (Boston : Doctrinal Tract and Book Society, 1854)

_excluded.park-edited: The Atonement: discourses and treatises (1859), the Sabbath Hymn Book and the Works of Samuel Hopkins: collections he edited of other men's work; Selections from German Literature (with Edwards)
